title: Simulation RPG Tkool
native_title: シミュレーションＲＰＧツクール
overview:
Heated battle scenes, event scenes that weave the battlefield - all of it is in your hands!!

Simulation RPG Tkool is a construction kit for building your own strategy RPG, with no programming knowledge needed. Design the story, the battlefields and the armies, then play through the campaign you made.

Assemble battle maps from parts such as plains, caves and ships, place treasure chests, signs and other events on them, and set the victory and defeat conditions for each map. Tell your story through conversation scenes with face graphics, chosen from a ready-made set or drawn yourself in the face editor. Create weapons, magic and items, including the effects shown in battle, and build a class system where characters gain skills and change classes as they grow.

- Characters you create fight across the battlefields you design
- Free-form event and story scenes
- Editable face graphics and battle effects
- One player. Saving requires a Power Memory cartridge
